name: stats-section
title: Stats Section
blurb: Dark-themed section with animated stats grid and narrative copy on a two-column…
description: Full-section component with dark background (neutral-950) and purple radial gradient. Left column shows heading, stat grid (Founded, Remote, Capital, Partners), and right column contains narrative paragraphs. Stats animate in on scroll…
use_when: Startup or company About sections where you want to combine stats with narrative storytelling.
avoid_when: Reusable stats component; data and text are hardcoded.
a11y: Semantic section and heading elements (h2 with br for line break). Stats animate but all text is readable. Purple gradient background uses radial-gradient, which is purely decorative.
